``` {r setup, include=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# 1. Global Configuration & Environment
# ==============================================================================
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
options(scipen = 999, digits = 4)

# Configuration: Sum-to-zero contrasts for valid Type III ANOVA results 
# and valid zero-correlation parameterizations.
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Global Settings & Analysis Targets (SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration: Set experiment version to match upstream preprocessing pipeline output.
experiment_version <- "E2"  # Options: "E1" or "E2"

# Configuration: Define the primary continuous covariate for the structural model.
# The load_covariates function automatically extracts and Z-transforms the following:
# "SVO_angle_Z", "Negative_Affectivity_Z", "Detachment_Z", "Antagonism_Z", 
# "Disinhibition_Z", "Anankastia_Z", "Psychoticism_Z", 
# "Rating_1_Z", "Rating_2_Z", "Rating_3_Z"
primary_covariate <- "Negative_Affectivity_Z" 

# Configuration: Define the theoretical role of the covariate in the LMM.
# "control"  -> y ~ emotion * offer + covariate (ANCOVA style, parallel slopes)
# "moderate" -> y ~ emotion * offer * covariate (Moderation style, variable slopes)
covariate_role <- "control" 

# Dynamic component definitions based on experimental design.
# Format: c("Component_Name" = Include_Covariate_Boolean)
if (experiment_version == "E1") {
  analyze_stim_components <- c(
    "EPN"       = TRUE,
    "FRN"       = TRUE,
    "N400"      = TRUE,
    "LPP_offer" = TRUE
  )
} else if (experiment_version == "E2") {
  analyze_stim_components <- c(
    "N170"      = TRUE,
    "EPN"       = TRUE,
    "FRN"       = TRUE,
    "N400"      = TRUE,
    "LPP_offer" = TRUE
  )
} else {
  stop("Configuration Error: Unknown experiment_version.")
}

analyze_resp_components <- c(
  "CPP"       = FALSE
)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if(!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(
  here, readr, readxl, dplyr, tidyr, stringr,  # Data Wrangling
  lme4, lmerTest,                              # Modeling
  car, parameters, performance,                # Diagnostics & APA Extraction
  buildmer,                                    # Random Structure Optimization
  emmeans, effectsize,                         # Statistical Inference
  sjPlot, sjmisc,                              # Quick Visualization
  ggplot2, ggpubr, gridExtra,                  # Publication Visualization
  openxlsx                                     # Excel Reporting
)

# Configuration: Force calculation of Denominator DF parameters for strict inferential tests
emmeans::emm_options(lmerTest.limit = 50000, pbkrtest.limit = 50000)

# Path definition: Dynamic Output Directory mapping to experiment_version
out_root <- here("results", "EEG", paste0(experiment_version, "_Stats_Regression_Method"))
if(!dir.exists(out_root)) dir.create(out_root, recursive = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("Initializing statistical pipeline for Experiment: %s\nRoot Output Directory: %s\nTarget Covariate: %s\nRole: %s\n", 
            experiment_version, out_root, primary_covariate, toupper(covariate_role)))

# Visual Theme & Palettes
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 14) + 
          theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top"))

colors_emo <- c('neu'="#8491B4",'aff'="#91D1C2",'dis'="#E64B35",'dom'="#F39B7F",'enj'="#3C5488")
labels_emo <- c('neu'='Neutral','aff'='Affiliative','dis'='Disgust','dom'='Dominance','enj'='Reward')
colors_off <- c('fair'="#2E86AB",'unfair'="#A23B72")
labels_off <- c('fair'='Fair', 'unfair'='Unfair')

custom_control <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000), calc.derivs = FALSE)
```

``` {r apa-module}
# ==============================================================================
# Helper: Universal Type Conversion, Missing Value Handler & Column Purger
# ==============================================================================
kill_scipen <- function(df) {
  df_clean <- df %>% 
    mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ {
      vec <- .
      if(is.numeric(vec)) {
        vec <- format(round(vec, 4), scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
      }
      vec <- ifelse(vec == "Inf" | vec == "-Inf" | is.infinite(vec), "Inf", vec)
      vec <- ifelse(is.na(vec) | vec == "NA", "-", as.character(vec))
      vec
    }))
  
  df_clean <- df_clean %>% select(where(~ !all(. == "-")))
  return(df_clean)
}

# ==============================================================================
# Helper: Significance Stars Generator
# ==============================================================================
add_sig_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "-",
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    p < 0.1   ~ ".",
    TRUE      ~ "ns"
  )
}

# ==============================================================================
# Helper: Map Sum-Coding Suffixes back to Actual Factor Levels globally
# ==============================================================================
beautify_labels <- function(df) {
  dict <- c(
    "\\bemotion1\\b" = "emotion[neu]",
    "\\bemotion2\\b" = "emotion[aff]",
    "\\bemotion3\\b" = "emotion[dis]",
    "\\bemotion4\\b" = "emotion[dom]",
    "\\boffer_type1\\b" = "offer_type[fair]",
    "\\boffer_type2\\b" = "offer_type[unfair]"
  )
  df %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ stringr::str_replace_all(., dict)))
}

# ==============================================================================
# Helper: Format ANOVA Table to APA String 
# ==============================================================================
format_anova_apa <- function(anova_obj, model) {
  df_res <- as.data.frame(anova_obj) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("Effect")
  
  es_df <- data.frame(Parameter = character(), Eta2_partial = numeric())
  tryCatch({
    es <- effectsize::eta_squared(model, partial = TRUE, ci = 0.95, verbose = FALSE)
    es_df <- as.data.frame(es) %>% select(Parameter, Eta2_partial)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if(nrow(es_df) > 0) {
    df_res <- left_join(df_res, es_df, by = c("Effect" = "Parameter"))
  } else {
    df_res$Eta2_partial <- NA
  }
  
  get_col <- function(col_name) if(col_name %in% names(df_res)) df_res[[col_name]] else NA
  
  df_res <- df_res %>%
    mutate(
      F_val  = get_col("F value"), 
      NumDF  = get_col("NumDF"), 
      DenDF  = get_col("DenDF"), 
      Df_val = get_col("Df"),
      p_val  = get_col("Pr(>F)"),
      Sig = add_sig_stars(p_val),
      p_str = case_when(
        is.na(p_val) ~ "-", 
        p_val < .001 ~ "< .001", 
        TRUE ~ paste0("= ", format(round(p_val, 3), scientific=FALSE, trim=TRUE))
      ),
      Eta_str = ifelse(is.na(Eta2_partial), "-", format(round(Eta2_partial, 2), scientific=FALSE, trim=TRUE)),
      
      APA_Report = case_when(
        !is.na(F_val) & !is.na(NumDF) & !is.na(DenDF) ~ sprintf("F(%s, %.2f) = %.2f, p %s, np2 = %s", NumDF, DenDF, F_val, p_str, Eta_str),
        !is.na(F_val) & !is.na(NumDF) & is.na(DenDF) ~ sprintf("F(%s, -) = %.2f, p %s, np2 = %s", NumDF, F_val, p_str, Eta_str),
        !is.na(F_val) & !is.na(Df_val) ~ sprintf("F(%s) = %.2f, p %s, np2 = %s", Df_val, F_val, p_str, Eta_str),
        TRUE ~ "Format error: Unrecognized test statistic"
      )
    ) %>% 
    select(Effect, APA_Report, Sig, F_val, NumDF, DenDF, Df_val, Eta2_partial, p_val)
  
  return(beautify_labels(kill_scipen(df_res)))
}

# ==============================================================================
# Helper: Format Post-hoc tests 
# ==============================================================================
format_posthoc_apa <- function(emm_df) {
  df_clean <- as.data.frame(emm_df)
  
  est_col <- intersect(names(df_clean), c("estimate", "response", "odds.ratio", "emmean"))
  if(length(est_col) == 0) {
    trend_col <- grep("\\.trend$", names(df_clean), value = TRUE)
    if(length(trend_col) > 0) est_col <- trend_col[1] else est_col <- names(df_clean)[2]
  } else {
    est_col <- est_col[1]
  }
  
  df_clean <- df_clean %>% 
    mutate(
      Sig = add_sig_stars(p.value),
      p_str = case_when(p.value < .001 ~ "< .001", TRUE ~ paste0("= ", format(round(p.value, 3), scientific=FALSE, trim=TRUE)))
    )
  
  if("t.ratio" %in% names(df_clean)) {
    df_clean <- df_clean %>% mutate(
      Stats_String = sprintf("b = %.2f (SE = %.2f), t(%s) = %.2f, p %s", !!sym(est_col), SE, ifelse(is.infinite(df), "Inf", round(df, 2)), t.ratio, p_str)
    )
  } else if("z.ratio" %in% names(df_clean)) {
    df_clean <- df_clean %>% mutate(
      Stats_String = sprintf("b = %.2f (SE = %.2f), z = %.2f, p %s", !!sym(est_col), SE, z.ratio, p_str)
    )
  } else {
    df_clean <- df_clean %>% mutate(
      Stats_String = sprintf("b = %.2f (SE = %.2f), p %s", !!sym(est_col), SE, p_str)
    )
  }
  
  df_clean <- df_clean %>% select(-p_str) %>% relocate(Sig, .after = Stats_String)
  return(beautify_labels(kill_scipen(df_clean)))
}

# ==============================================================================
# Helper: Format Raw Coefficients and Map Contrast Names
# ==============================================================================
format_coefs <- function(model) {
  df_out <- tryCatch({
    df_params <- as.data.frame(parameters::model_parameters(model, ci = 0.95, effects = "fixed"))
    stat_col <- if("t" %in% names(df_params)) "t" else if("z" %in% names(df_params)) "z" else "Statistic"
    
    df_params %>% mutate(
      Sig = add_sig_stars(p),
      p_str = case_when(p < .001 ~ "< .001", TRUE ~ paste0("= ", format(round(p, 3), scientific=FALSE, trim=TRUE))),
      Report = sprintf("b = %.2f, SE = %.2f, %s = %.2f, p %s", Coefficient, SE, stat_col, !!sym(stat_col), p_str)
    ) %>% select(-p_str) %>% relocate(Sig, .after = Report)
    
  }, error = function(e) as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("Predictor"))
  
  return(beautify_labels(kill_scipen(df_out)))
}
```

``` {r prep-functions}
# ==============================================================================
# Data Loading & Cleaning Functions
# ==============================================================================
standardize_id <- function(ids) sprintf("Vp%04d", as.numeric(str_extract(ids, "\\d+")))

load_covariates <- function(path_cov) {
  if(!file.exists(path_cov)) { 
    warning("Covariate file missing. Returning NULL."); 
    return(NULL) 
  }
  cat(sprintf("   [Covariates] Loading: %s\n", basename(path_cov)))
  
  df_cov <- if(grepl("\\.csv$", path_cov)) read_csv(path_cov, show_col_types=FALSE) else read_excel(path_cov)
  names(df_cov)[1] <- "raw_id"
  df_cov$participant_id <- standardize_id(df_cov$raw_id)
  
  # Definition of all traits to extract from the raw covariate dataset
  target_traits <- c("SVO_angle", "Negative_Affectivity", "Detachment", "Antagonism",
                     "Disinhibition", "Anankastia", "Psychoticism",
                     "Rating_1", "Rating_2", "Rating_3")
  
  # Auto-standardization implementation mapping across target traits
  df_cov_clean <- df_cov %>% 
    select(participant_id, any_of(c("SVO_type", target_traits))) %>%
    mutate(across(any_of(target_traits), 
                  ~ as.numeric(scale(.)), 
                  .names = "{.col}_Z"))
  
  return(df_cov_clean)
}

load_and_prep <- function(path_erp, df_covariates, erp_name, baseline_col) {
  if(!file.exists(path_erp)) stop("ERP file missing")
  df <- read_csv(path_erp, show_col_types=FALSE)
  
  if(!(erp_name %in% names(df))) {
    cat(sprintf("   [SKIP] Component '%s' not found in dataset.\n", erp_name))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df$participant_id <- standardize_id(df$participant_id)
  
  df <- df %>%
    filter(Offers_Other %in% c(5, 6, 8, 9)) %>%
    mutate(
      offer_type = factor(case_when(Offers_Other %in% c(5,6)~"fair", Offers_Other %in% c(8,9)~"unfair"), levels = c("fair", "unfair")),
      emotion = factor(emotion, levels = c("neu", "aff", "dis", "dom", "enj"))
    )
  
  orig_n <- nrow(df)
  df <- df %>% filter(abs(!!sym(erp_name)) < 200)
  if(orig_n > nrow(df)) cat(sprintf("   [QC] %s: Dropped %d trials > 200µV\n", erp_name, orig_n-nrow(df)))
  
  if(!is.null(baseline_col) && baseline_col %in% names(df)) {
    df$Baseline_Raw <- df[[baseline_col]]
    df$Baseline_c <- as.numeric(scale(df$Baseline_Raw, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE))
  } else { df$Baseline_c <- 0 }
  
  if(!is.null(df_covariates)) df <- left_join(df, df_covariates, by = "participant_id")
  return(df)
}

check_uniqueness <- function(df, context_name) {
  if(nrow(df) != n_distinct(select(df, participant_id, index))) 
    stop(sprintf("CRITICAL ERROR: Duplicate keys (ID+Index) found in %s", context_name))
}
```

``` {r stats-engine}
# ==============================================================================
# Analytical Engine: Linear Mixed-Effects Modeling
# ==============================================================================
run_regression_analysis <- function(data, erp_name, out_dir, exp_version, use_cov = FALSE) {
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Dynamic Safe Output Directory Generation (Prevents Overwriting)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  analysis_tag <- if(use_cov && primary_covariate %in% names(data)) {
    paste0(str_to_title(covariate_role), "_", primary_covariate)
  } else {
    "BaseModel_NoCov"
  }
  
  # Directory tree: Root / ERP_Component / Analysis_Tag
  sub_dir <- file.path(out_dir, erp_name, analysis_tag)
  if(!dir.exists(sub_dir)) dir.create(sub_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  cat(sprintf("\n>>> Analyzing Component: %s [%s] (N = %d)\n    Saving to: %s\n", 
              erp_name, exp_version, n_distinct(data$participant_id), basename(sub_dir)))
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Baseline Logic & Fixed Effects Specification
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  baseline_formula <- "+ Baseline_c"
  
  if(use_cov && primary_covariate %in% names(data)) {
    if(covariate_role == "moderate") {
      cat(sprintf("   [Config] Moderation Mode: Including %s as an interacting moderator (*)...\n", primary_covariate))
      fixed_effects <- paste0(erp_name, " ~ emotion * offer_type * ", primary_covariate, " ", baseline_formula)
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("   [Config] Control Mode: Including %s as an additive covariate (+)...\n", primary_covariate))
      fixed_effects <- paste0(erp_name, " ~ emotion * offer_type + ", primary_covariate, " ", baseline_formula)
    }
  } else {
    fixed_effects <- paste0(erp_name, " ~ emotion * offer_type ", baseline_formula)
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Random Effects Structure Optimization (Data-Driven Maximal Approach)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  cat("   [Phase 1] Optimizing Random Structure via backward LRT (Zero-Corr)...\n")
  random_maximal <- "+ (1 | participant_id) + (0 + emotion | participant_id) + (0 + offer_type | participant_id) + (0 + emotion:offer_type | participant_id)"
  
  f_buildmer <- as.formula(paste(fixed_effects, random_maximal))
  bm_res <- buildmer::buildmer(
    formula = f_buildmer, 
    data = data,
    buildmerControl = buildmerControl(
      include = as.formula(paste("~", str_split(fixed_effects, "~")[[1]][2])),
      direction = c("order", "backward"), crit = "LRT", quiet = TRUE, args = list(control = custom_control)
    )
  )
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Final Model Fit & Inferential Statistics
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  cat("   [Phase 2] Fitting final optimized model (REML)...\n")
  final_formula <- formula(bm_res@model)
  FINAL_MODEL <- lmer(final_formula, data = data, REML = TRUE, control = custom_control)
  
  formula_str <- paste(deparse(final_formula), collapse = " ")
  cat("\n   [FINAL MODEL FORMULA]:\n   ", str_squish(formula_str), "\n\n")

  anova_res <- anova(FINAL_MODEL, type = 3, ddf = "Satterthwaite")
  anova_apa <- format_anova_apa(anova_res, FINAL_MODEL)
  print(anova_apa %>% select(Effect, APA_Report))

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Post-hoc Interactions & Simple Effects
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  cat("   [Phase 3] Marginal Means & Post-hoc Contrasts (FDR corrected)...\n")
  
  target_term_2way <- "emotion:offer_type"
  target_term_3way <- paste0("emotion:offer_type:", primary_covariate)
  
  analyze_3way_mod <- use_cov && (covariate_role == "moderate") && (target_term_3way %in% row.names(anova_res))
  
  p_int_3way <- if(analyze_3way_mod) anova_res[target_term_3way, "Pr(>F)"] else 1.0
  if(is.na(p_int_3way)) p_int_3way <- 1.0
  
  p_int_2way <- anova_res[target_term_2way, "Pr(>F)"]
  if(is.na(p_int_2way)) p_int_2way <- 1.0
  
  at_list <- list(Baseline_c = 0)
  if(analyze_3way_mod && p_int_3way < 0.05) {
    at_list[[primary_covariate]] <- c(-1, 1) 
  }
  
  list_of_tables <- list(
    "ANOVA_Main" = anova_apa, 
    "Model_Formula" = data.frame(Formula = formula_str), 
    "Model_Coefficients" = format_coefs(FINAL_MODEL)
  )
  
  if (analyze_3way_mod && p_int_3way < 0.05) {
    cat(sprintf("      -> Significant 3-Way Moderation (%s). Computing Simple Slopes and Conditional Effects...\n", primary_covariate))
    
    em_trends <- emtrends(FINAL_MODEL, ~ emotion * offer_type, var = primary_covariate, at = at_list)
    list_of_tables[["Simple_Slopes_Covariate"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(test(em_trends, adjust = "fdr"))
    
    f_conditional <- as.formula(paste("~ offer_type | emotion |", primary_covariate))
    list_of_tables[["Cond_Offer_by_Emotion_at_Cov"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(
      pairs(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, f_conditional, at = at_list), adjust="fdr")
    )
    
  } else if (p_int_2way < 0.05) {
    cat("      -> Significant 2-Way Interaction detected. Decomposing bidirectional simple effects.\n")
    list_of_tables[["Simple_Offer_by_Emotion"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(
      pairs(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, as.formula("~ offer_type | emotion"), at = at_list), adjust="fdr")
    )
    list_of_tables[["Simple_Emotion_by_Offer"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(
      pairs(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, as.formula("~ emotion | offer_type"), at = at_list), adjust="fdr")
    )
  } else {
    cat("      -> No robust interactions detected. Reporting Main Effects.\n")
    list_of_tables[["Main_Effect_Offer"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(
      pairs(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~ offer_type, at = at_list), adjust="fdr")
    )
    list_of_tables[["Main_Effect_Emotion"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(
      pairs(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~ emotion, at = at_list), adjust="fdr")
    )
    
    if (p_int_2way < 0.10) {
      cat("      -> Marginal Interaction detected (p < .10). Adding uncorrected exploratory effects.\n")
      list_of_tables[["Exploratory_Simple_Offer"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(
        pairs(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, as.formula("~ offer_type | emotion"), at = at_list), adjust="none")
      )
    }
  }

  desc_formula <- paste("~ offer_type * emotion", if(analyze_3way_mod && p_int_3way < 0.05) paste("*", primary_covariate) else "")
  list_of_tables[["Descriptive_Means_SE"]] <- beautify_labels(kill_scipen(
    as.data.frame(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, as.formula(desc_formula), at = at_list))
  ))
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Data Export & Visualization
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  for(sheet_name in names(list_of_tables)) {
    safe_sheet_name <- substr(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", sheet_name), 1, 31)
    addWorksheet(wb, safe_sheet_name)
    writeData(wb, safe_sheet_name, list_of_tables[[sheet_name]])
    addStyle(wb, safe_sheet_name, createStyle(textDecoration="bold", border="Bottom"), rows=1, cols=1:ncol(list_of_tables[[sheet_name]]))
  }
  
  # Dynamic File Name to further reflect the specific analysis
  file_suffix <- paste0(exp_version, "_", erp_name, "_", analysis_tag)
  saveWorkbook(wb, file.path(sub_dir, paste0("STATS_", file_suffix, ".xlsx")), overwrite = TRUE)

  cat("   [Phase 4] Generating diagnostic and interaction plots...\n")
  try({
    p_forest <- sjPlot::plot_model(FINAL_MODEL, type = "est", show.values = TRUE, show.p = TRUE, 
                                   title = paste(erp_name, "Coefficients\n(", analysis_tag, ")")) + theme_bw()
    ggsave(file.path(sub_dir, paste0("Diag_Forest_", file_suffix, ".png")), p_forest, width = 6, height = 8)
  })

  if(analyze_3way_mod && p_int_3way < 0.05) {
      pd <- as.data.frame(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, as.formula(desc_formula), at = at_list))
      pd$Cov_Group <- factor(pd[[primary_covariate]], labels=c("Low (-1SD)", "High (+1SD)"))
      
      p_final <- ggplot(pd, aes(x = emotion, y = emmean, color = offer_type, group = offer_type)) +
           facet_wrap(~Cov_Group) + geom_line(linewidth=1.2, position=position_dodge(0.2)) + 
           geom_point(size=3, position=position_dodge(0.2)) +
           geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=emmean-SE, ymax=emmean+SE), width=0.2, position=position_dodge(0.2)) +
           scale_color_manual(values = colors_off, labels = labels_off) +
           labs(title = paste(exp_version, erp_name, "moderated by", primary_covariate), 
                y = "Amplitude (µV)", x = "Emotion Condition")
  } else {
      pd <- as.data.frame(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~ offer_type * emotion, at = at_list))
      p_final <- ggplot(pd, aes(x = emotion, y = emmean, color = offer_type, group = offer_type)) +
           geom_line(linewidth=1.2, position=position_dodge(0.2)) + 
           geom_point(size=3.5, shape=21, fill="white", stroke=2, position=position_dodge(0.2)) +
           geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=emmean-SE, ymax=emmean+SE), width=0.2, position=position_dodge(0.2)) +
           scale_color_manual(values = colors_off, labels = labels_off) + scale_x_discrete(labels = labels_emo) +
           labs(title = paste(exp_version, erp_name, "Interaction Effect"),
                subtitle = paste("Configuration:", analysis_tag),
                y = "Amplitude (µV)", x = "Emotion Condition")
  }
  ggsave(file.path(sub_dir, paste0("Plot_", file_suffix, ".png")), p_final, width = 8, height = 6)
  
  cat("   >>> Analysis Complete.\n")
}
```

``` {r execution}
# ==============================================================================
# Execution Phase
# ==============================================================================
path_pipeline <- here("data", paste0("02_Pipeline_Output_", experiment_version))
path_stim <- file.path(path_pipeline, "Method_Regression", "Stimulus_Locked", "trials.csv")
path_resp <- file.path(path_pipeline, "Method_Regression", "Response_Locked", "trials.csv")

path_cov_base <- file.path(path_pipeline, "Covariates")
path_cov_candidates <- c(
  file.path(path_cov_base, sprintf("SVO_PID5BF_PostRating_%s.csv", experiment_version)),
  file.path(path_cov_base, sprintf("SVO_PID5BF_PostRating_%s.xlsx", experiment_version)),
  file.path(path_cov_base, "SVO_PID5BF_PostRating.csv"),
  file.path(path_cov_base, "SVO_PID5BF_PostRating.xlsx")
)

path_cov <- NA_character_
for(cand in path_cov_candidates) {
  if(file.exists(cand)) {
    path_cov <- cand
    break
  }
}

if(is.na(path_cov)) warning("No covariate file found in candidate paths.")
if(!file.exists(path_stim)) stop(sprintf("Stimulus file not found at: %s\nVerify upstream preprocessing.", path_stim, experiment_version))

cat("--- Loading Covariates ---\n")
df_covs <- load_covariates(path_cov)

if(file.exists(path_stim)) {
  cat("\n=== Processing Stimulus-Locked Components ===\n")
  for (comp_name in names(analyze_stim_components)) {
    use_cov_flag <- as.logical(analyze_stim_components[comp_name])
    baseline_col_name <- paste0("Baseline_", comp_name)
    df_comp <- load_and_prep(path_stim, df_covs, comp_name, baseline_col_name)
    
    if (!is.null(df_comp)) {
      run_regression_analysis(df_comp, comp_name, out_root, experiment_version, use_cov = use_cov_flag)
    }
  }
}

if(file.exists(path_resp) && file.exists(path_stim)) {
  cat("\n=== Processing Response-Locked Components ===\n")
  df_stim_base <- read_csv(path_stim, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(participant_id = ifelse(grepl("^\\d+$", as.character(participant_id)), 
                                   sprintf("Vp%04d", as.numeric(participant_id)), as.character(participant_id)))
  
  for (comp_name in names(analyze_resp_components)) {
    use_cov_flag <- as.logical(analyze_resp_components[comp_name])
    df_comp_raw <- load_and_prep(path_resp, df_covs, comp_name, NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(df_comp_raw)) {
      check_uniqueness(df_comp_raw, comp_name); check_uniqueness(df_stim_base, "Base")
      
      df_comp_merged <- left_join(df_comp_raw, df_stim_base %>% select(participant_id, index, Baseline_LPP_offer), by = c("participant_id", "index"))
      df_comp_merged$Baseline_Raw <- df_comp_merged$Baseline_LPP_offer
      df_comp_merged$Baseline_c <- as.numeric(scale(df_comp_merged$Baseline_Raw, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE))
      
      run_regression_analysis(df_comp_merged %>% filter(!is.na(Baseline_c)), comp_name, out_root, experiment_version, use_cov = use_cov_flag)
    }
  }
}

cat(sprintf("\n========================================\n   %s Master Analysis Pipeline Completed.\n========================================\n", experiment_version))


```
